main.description: What one receiving space may see of this space: the rooms of this space it is granted access to. One record per receiving space, written to the origin space's repo — the origin space's admins are the ones who decide it.

federatingSpace.description: The receiving space. The same DID the record key names.

origin.description: The rooms of this space the receiving space may see. Absent an entry, the room is invisible to it.

room.description: The room: the record key of a `space.roomy.space.room` record.
